description: Ministry of Lanka & Parliamentary Reforms - Appointed Mrs. M. B. M. W. H. K. Abesinghe as an Acquirig Officer for Central Expressway Project.
reasoning: This gazette notification is primarily about land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an Acquiring Officer under the Land Acquisition Act for Phase III of the Central Expressway Project. The content focuses on land acquisition procedures and authority delegation for property matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister and includes an appointment, the core subject matter is land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
